task: anytime terminal prediction for stationary finite-mean binary renewal processes

interface.data: one raw stationary binary path, observed prefix x_1^t
interface.source_class: stationary renewal processes with iid positive-integer gaps and arbitrary finite mean

main_claim: For every t>=1, the current-length suffix-average predictor has expected terminal KL at most [pi*sqrt(2t/3)+2*log(t+1)+log(2)+log(t+2)]/t <= 8/sqrt(t).
construction: At prefix length t, use the fixed-horizon Q_{t+1} code and its own prefix conditionals in HJW suffix averaging. Define a separate sequential law as the product of these causal outputs, with fair initial X_1 code; this law is projective. No Q_{t+1} is assumed to be a marginal of another Q_N.
limitations: No claim of pointwise likelihood domination for the new sequential law.
No sublinear-memory online update; raw history is retained and the predictor is recomputed.
No broad anytime-prediction priority search or external proof review.
